m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into chips, toss with a good drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt on a lined tray, and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

Thinly slice {onion}. Cook in a drizzle of oil with a pinch of salt over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden and sticky. Add {brownsugar} and {whitevinegar} for the last 2 minutes.
Put {beef_rump} between two sheets of baking paper and bash with a rolling pin to about 1cm thick. Season well with salt and pepper.

Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until smoking. Sear the steaks for 1 to 2 minutes a side. In the last 30 seconds, lay a cheese slice on each (you'll use {slices} in all) to melt. Rest for 3 minutes, then slice.
Split {turkish} and toast cut side down in the pan.
Spread the rolls with {mayo}, then add {cos}, sliced {cherrytom}, the steak and cheese, and plenty of onions. Serve with the chips.

l: Steak and onions over salad, or in a wrap. Keep the bread separate so it doesn't go soggy. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF buns instead of Turkish rolls, toasted separately.
